description: House Majority Leader John Bell’s “pragmatic and nature-based solutions” to statewide flood and storm preparedness earned him “Legislator of the Year” recognition on Sept. 11 at North Carolina Wildlife Federation’s 57th Annual Governor’s Conservation Achievement Awards.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: Majority Leader John Bell Earns “Legislator of the Year” Award from NC Wildlife Federation
